title: 【Marvelous Designer 12.1 New Features Demonstration】Compatibility with USD File Format and Omniverse Connector
description: Thank you all for your continued support~ Marvelous Designer 12.1 has now been officially released! For more optimized features, please visit the new features page on the official website!~

summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer 12.1 New Features Demonstration **Video Context:** This video is sponsored by Omniverse Connector. Marvelous Designer 12.1 is now compatible with the USD file format and Omniverse Connector. ## Opening the Omniverse Connector 1. Click the **copy button** in the upper right corner of any window to open the Omniverse Connector window and the USD layer window. 2. Drag these windows to the right position. ## Creating a USD File 1. Click the **Create button** in the USD layer window to save the path and name to create an empty USD file. 2. The newly created file will automatically be set to **authoring layer.usd**. 3. You can create multiple USD layers, but you can only change one of them. 4. If you want to edit the selected USD file under the authoring layer, select the 3D or 2D window of the USD file, then click the button in the upper right corner of any window to export it to the USD layer. 5. If there is no authoring layer at the moment, click the **Create button** in the USD layer window to create a new one. ## Exporting Clothes 1. After setting up the **PREM path**, you can export the clothes. 2. According to the 3D clothing rendering style when exporting, the results will vary: - If the current 3D clothing rendering style is a thick texture surface, it will export the clothes with thickness. 3. To export all the objects in the scene at the same time, go to **File** in the main menu and select **Export to USD**. 4. In the exporting USD window, select the object type you want to export. You can choose to export thin or thick and set the PREM path to complete the export. ## Importing USD Files 1. Use the **import button** in the USD layer window or the main menu to import the USD file. 2. In the USD layer window, select the download type and object type. 3. If you want to import it as a virtual model, you can choose to automatically create a test穿服. 4. The USD file will be successfully imported, and the grid and material will appear in the USD layer window, automatically exported to the main menu. ## Setting Up 3D Clothing Rendering Style 1. Import the 3D clothing rendering style. 2. The 3D clothing rendering style has been set to be an **Authoring layer**. 3. If you would like to save the objects in the current scene and add an extra block to the USD file, replace the **plus option** in the USD window. 4. Alternatively, enter the file in the menu to add a new layer of USD. 5. Click the **Clear button** to clear all layers in the USD layer window. You can still find these objects in the 3D window because they are part of the scene. ## Connecting to the Omniverse Server 1. Connect to the Omniverse server by clicking the icon in the upper right corner of the Omniverse Connector window and selecting **Add Server** in the drop-down menu. 2. Enter the name of the server you want to connect to and click **Add Server**. For reference, I entered "localhost" here. 3. To use Omniverse Connector with Omniverse Create, ensure you connect to the same server as Marvelous Designer. ## Working with USD Files in Omniverse Create 1. Open a USD file in Omniverse Create. 2. To import text and objects simultaneously, make sure the text folder and USD folder are stored in the same path. 3. In the **Live menu** in the upper right corner, select **Create Drawing**. 4. In the Live Session, click the name of the drawing in the window to create a new drawing. 5. In Marvelous Designer, open the same USD file you opened in Omniverse Create. 6. Enter the drawing you created in Omniverse Create by clicking the Omniverse Connector icon, selecting the drawing's name, and clicking **Add**. ## Managing Live Sessions 1. After successfully entering the drawing, go back to the USD layer window. A **Live Session layer** will appear. 2. If another participant is adding to your drawing, you can click the **refresh participant button** to update participant information. 3. When the Live Session layer set to Authoring is exported to the USD operation, you will see the file update in Omniverse Create. 4. However, changes made in the normal USD layer set to Authoring will not affect the objects in Omniverse Create. ## Synchronizing Changes 1. When the **BaseUSD file** is in the window, click the **Fetch button** to synchronize changes in Omniverse Create. 2. To leave the current drawing, open Omniverse Connect and click on the **Leave Drawing** menu below. 3. After clicking the **Leave Drawing button**, you can click **View** to exit. ```
